description: As a web developer, you need to analyze your site's access log stored at /home/user/access.log to determine how many times each unique IP address accessed your site. Please do the following: 1. Count the frequency of each unique IP address that appears as the first field (before the first space) on every line of /home/user/access.log. 2. Output your results to a file named /home/user/ip_frequency.log. 3. The output format must be as follows: - Each line should contain the count of accesses, followed by a single space, then the IP address. - The lines must be sorted in ascending order of IP address (not by frequency). - For example: 23 192.168.1.11 4. If any IP address appears only once, it should still be included in the results. Create /home/user/ip_frequency.log containing these results. If you want to verify your results, you can print the first few lines of /home/user/ip_frequency.log to the console.
